reviews.title: Not good, took money but can’t access the lessons.
reviews.text: I subscribed for a month on Sunday 20th September.  I just logged back in today 24th September and it has not saved any of my progress.  Plus it has only allowed me to access a few free trial lessons and the rest are locked, it keeps asking me to subscribe.         When I click restore purchase it tells me I have already purchased Premium!  I have deleted the app and downloaded it again and it makes no difference.    I sent a message to report the issue and got an automated AI message back saying responses take  1 day!    Thank goodness I only subscribed for 1 month and not the whole year.   Looks like I wont be using this app again.                              Well an update,  support got back to me a day later - not sure is this was an actual person or AI - they told me I had signed in with the wrong email - this is incorrect I had no difficulty signing in and the subscription part of the app recognised I was signed in and that I had a premium subscription as it told me that when I tried to restore the subscription - but the lesson part of the app did not recognise that I had a premium subscription and will only give me a few lessons with the rest not locked.         Soooo I will not be renewing the monthly subscription - Ive already lost 2 days use of it and am no further forward.

reviews.title: Subscriptions
reviews.text: In my personal experience, I was eager to expand my repertoire of songs on this application. However, during the initial lesson, I encountered a significant obstacle: I was unable to advance to the subsequent lesson without a subscription. My objective was to acquire new musical knowledge and perform captivating pieces with my piano companions. Regrettably, I have been unable to locate an application that provides lessons without the necessity of a subscription.

reviews.title: Disappointing and Frustrating
reviews.text: Yamaha gave me a 3 month free trial. I started well but after a couple of weeks the app is marking the first note of each second bar red even though I did get a green tick above the note. As a result the app won’t let me move on through the course. It’s so an annoying as I’m definitely playing the correct note having played piano some years ago. This is on a digital piano so it’s not out of tune. I’ve deleted the app and reinstalled. The app version is up to date. If this problem isn’t fixed by the time my trial runs out I won’t be paying for a subscription.

reviews.title: flowkey be like…
reviews.text: The beginner lessons were useful. Now that I’m doing the intermediate lessons, I feel like the app over punishes you for minor mistakes by making you play at an excessively slow tempo and does not do well at recognizing what notes my keyboard is playing when the music has multiple notes played at once. Because of this lessons can be very frustrating and not fun which hinders progress. I wish there were more options to practice music reading on the because I find myself relying on the videos more than the musical notes pretty often.
